patterns: APPSC asks one-line definitions: repo rate (RBI lends to banks), REPO borrowing = LAF, 'required reserve ratio' = CRR, SLR value in a review year.
Effect questions recur: raising CRR -> less money in circulation and lower demand (trap: not more lending/purchasing power); bank rate cut -> more liquidity.
Quantitative vs qualitative credit control classification is a favourite (variable reserve ratios/OMO = quantitative; margin, moral suasion, rationing = selective).
Recent APPSC Group-2 items test SDF (absorbs liquidity without collateral), I-CRR and fine-tuning ops; snapshot-rate questions tied to a policy date.
App MCQs go deeper (transmission channels, EBLR/MCLR history, stances, swaps) with many multi-statement items; APPSC is mostly direct and definitional.
